UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Google user profile record for TruthLens analysts.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name from Google account or user settings.

photoUrl.description: Profile photo URL from Google Auth.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID, containing Google sign-in identity fields.
